# Support and Private Contact

## Public Routes

- Questions, ideas, research extensions, and use cases: https://github.com/mmjbds/mianzhang.org/discussions
- Scoped artifact work: https://github.com/mmjbds/mianzhang.org/issues/new/choose
- Contribution guide: [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- Public community map: https://mianzhang.org/community/

Public routes are not customer-support systems and must not contain confidential data.

## Private Route

Use `373743743@qq.com` for:

- Security or privacy reports that cannot be made public.
- Conduct reports.
- A bounded research, evaluation, or design-partner inquiry whose first message cannot be public.

In the first message, provide a short non-confidential summary, the affected public artifact or problem class, and a safe way to continue. Do not attach credentials, customer data, production logs, private prompts, account exports, or exploit details before a protected handling route is agreed.

No service level, commercial engagement, or confidentiality agreement is created by sending a message.
